names.zh: 索拉里斯诊断工具装饰

descriptions.en: A golden statue of Executor Tuvul, exalted member of the Orokin Seven. Patron of the Zariman Ten Zero expedition.

descriptions.zh: 一个金色的月动球奖杯。

descriptions.en: A gold trophy with a Lunaro ball.
descriptions.zh: 一个带有月动球的黄金奖杯。

descriptions.en: A small wobbly statue of Zephyr.
descriptions.zh: 一小座 Zephyr 摇头娃娃。

descriptions.zh: 一小座 Zephyr Prime 摇头娃娃。

descriptions.en: Install this segment in order to enable the Arsenal within your orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用军械库功能。

descriptions.en: Strengthen your Arsenal with Melee Arcanes. This segment unlocks Exilus Slots for your Melee Weapons.
descriptions.zh: 通过近战武器赋能强化你的军械库。这个模块会为你的近战武器解锁特殊功能槽。

descriptions.en: A foundry upgrade that allows two Forma to be crafted at the same time.
descriptions.zh: 允许在同一时间制造两个 FORMA 的铸造厂升级。

descriptions.en:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
descriptions.zh:
将轨道飞行器的铸造厂升级，可获得下列功能：

－可以制造登陆艇
－可以制造空中支持呼叫道具

在「军械库」>「携带装备」中装备「空中支援呼叫器」。

descriptions.en: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
descriptions.zh: 可以让孵化器繁殖库娃。

descriptions.en: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用宠物孵化器功能。

descriptions.en:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features:

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions
- Egg incubation reduced by a day
descriptions.zh:
升级轨道飞行器的孵化器来获得以下功能：

- 回退受老化基因影响的成熟同伴
- 孵化时间减少一天

descriptions.en: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.
descriptions.zh: 该模块允许 Helminth 将执刑官源力石嵌入当前战甲。执刑官源力石可以永久增强多种属性。

names.zh: HELMINTH 执刑官源力石模块

descriptions.en: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.
descriptions.zh: 通过联结融合和升华融合，可让 Helminth 融合执刑官源力石来获得更强大的源力石变体。

descriptions.en: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
descriptions.zh: 在轨道飞行器强化 Helminth，并解锁将新技能转移到战甲上的功能。

descriptions.en: Allows The Helminth to inject a Warframe with an Invigoration. Invigorations temporarily increase a Warframe's capabilities.
descriptions.zh: 允许 Helminth 为战甲注入活力。活化可以暂时增加战甲的能力。

descriptions.en: Install this segment to enable the Mod Fusion function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器的 Mod 终端机上以解锁 Mod 融铸功能。

descriptions.en: A Railjack Command Cephalon. Responsible for ships systems, mission completion and crew preservation.
descriptions.zh: 航道星舰指挥中枢。负责战舰系统、任务完成以及舰员保护。

descriptions.en: Resembling a Void Key, this object appears to be a perfect match for the empty slot in the Railjack's reliquary.
descriptions.zh: 与虚空钥匙类似，这个物品明显与航道星舰里圣物装置的钥匙孔相匹配。

descriptions.en: Install this Void Relic Segment in your Orbiter to begin opening Void Relics. Void Relics contain valuables that are only determined when opened in Void Fissure missions. Void Relics can be obtained as mission rewards.
descriptions.zh: 将此虚空遗物模块安装到你的轨道飞行器上，即可开启虚空遗物。虚空遗物内含的宝物只有在虚空裂缝任务中开启后才能确定。虚空遗物可以作为任务奖励获得。

descriptions.en: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!
descriptions.zh: 在限定时间内，为你的轨道飞行器添加各种节庆装饰吧！

descriptions.en: This blade-like landing craft is armed with Carpet Bomb air-support.
descriptions.zh: 这艘像刀刃一样的登陆艇装备了地毯式轰炸空中支援系统。

descriptions.en: The landing craft of choice utilised by the Tenno during their missions.
descriptions.zh: Tenno 执行任务期间会选择使用这艘登陆艇。

descriptions.en:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut's alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad's health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
descriptions.zh:
一艘为了 Tenno 增援而重新改装的 Grineer 博寇。伺航的警报信号呼叫卡尔和他的 Grineer 兄弟们来支援。当支援起作用时，使用警报信号来补充你的小队生命值。每个小队成员可以额外呼叫一名 Grineer 兄弟加入战斗。

完成《破障者》系列任务后也可在商店内购得。

descriptions.en: Featuring Sentry Gun air-support, this stylish landing craft is an asset in any battle.
descriptions.zh: 装备有自动炮台的空中支援系统，这艘时尚的登陆艇在任何战斗中都是实用的座驾。

descriptions.en: This insect-like landing craft features Med-Tower air-support.
descriptions.zh: 这架虫型的登陆艇装置了治愈塔，可支援空中作战。

descriptions.en: A landing craft model that pays homage to the forever-wandering home of pirate DJ Nora Night. Stay deadly, Dreamers. Nightwave's air support releases powerful sound waves, destroying weaker enemies while stunning more powerful ones.
descriptions.zh: 一款向海盗 DJ 诺拉·夜 的永恒漫游之家致敬的登陆艇型号。时刻保持强大与敏锐吧，梦回者。午夜电波的空中支援系统能够释放强力声波，它能摧毁弱小的敌人，同时也能让强大的敌人陷入眩晕。

descriptions.en: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PARALLAX）星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金之眼空中支援，可让殖民者在登陆前研究稀有资源丰富的地区。

descriptions.en:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
税务官将其称为对我们未来的投资，但是用来支付职业和专业培训的贷款几乎超过你的收入。尤其还有利息。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

descriptions.en:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
涵盖从栖所租金到保险，登陆许可和支付航道船舰的所有费用。高价物品。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

descriptions.en:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
要有更多工作，你需要改装。然后你需要更多的工作来支付改装，这样你才能得到更多的改装。所以我们现在才会这样。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

descriptions.en:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
有时候一个技工需要一些帮助，所以他们可以预支下一次的工资。高额利率几乎可以保证他们将一辈子来偿还这笔费用。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

descriptions.en:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
上一代未付清的债务由下一代承接。努力付出偿还债务被视为一种值得的骄傲。他们有还能有什么选择？

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得
